description: Feature 6 — Mood + note per fasting session. Use the OPTIONAL mood/note columns added in FEAT-001 (Mood enum + FastingSessionRecord.mood?/note?). After a fast is saved on stop/complete, offer a quick SKIPPABLE mood+note capture sheet that attaches to the just-saved row (via the session id stopFast now returns). Allow editing from a History row. Surface a small mood indicator in History and a pure mood aggregation (unit-tested) optionally shown on Stats. Optional + non-blocking; older rows with undefined mood/note stay valid everywhere. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, setMoodNote, stopFast returning the id).
steps: Read FIRST: the absolute context.json and this file. Depends on FEAT-001 (Mood type, FastingSessionRecord.mood?/note?, sessions.setMoodNote, stopFast returning Promise<number | null>).

src/lib/copy.ts: add `export const MOOD_LABELS: Record<Mood, string>` (energik/biasa/lemes/lapar -> Gojek labels, no emoji; import Mood from @/types) next to GOAL_LABELS, and a `mood` namespace in copy for the capture sheet (title e.g. 'Gimana rasanya puasa tadi?', note placeholder, Simpan, Lewati, and the History indicator aria label).

src/types/index.ts + src/components/ui/Icon.tsx: add IconKeys for the four moods mapped to verified io5 names: `mood_energik -> IoBatteryChargingOutline`, `mood_biasa -> IoRemoveCircleOutline`, `mood_lemes -> IoBatteryDeadOutline`, `mood_lapar -> IoFastFoodOutline`. Keep the map `satisfies`.

Create src/features/history/MoodNoteSheet.tsx ('use client', reuse src/components/ui/Sheet.tsx): props { open; sessionId: number | null; initialMood?: Mood; initialNote?: string; onClose }. Renders four mood chips (chip buttons or Segmented-style using MOOD_LABELS + mood icons via the Icon choke point), an optional short note textarea, and Simpan / Lewati actions. Simpan calls sessions.setMoodNote(sessionId, { mood, note }); Lewati just closes. Never blocks — closing without a choice is fine.

Wire post-stop capture: in src/features/timer/TimerControls.tsx handleStopConfirm, after `await stopFast()` capture the returned id and, when non-null, open the MoodNoteSheet for that id. In src/features/timer/FastingTimer.tsx handleStop (the complete-prompt stop), do the same with the returned id. Keep the existing toasts + clearScheduled. Capture is skippable and must not block the stop flow.

src/features/history/SessionRow.tsx: show a small mood indicator (mood icon + MOOD_LABELS text) when session.mood !== undefined (guard older rows), and make the row tappable to open MoodNoteSheet prefilled with the row's mood/note for editing. Keep the existing delete affordance and ConfirmDialog.

Create pure src/lib/mood.ts (NO React, NO @/db): `moodBreakdown(sessions: FastingSessionRecord[]): Record<Mood, number>` counting sessions per mood and ignoring rows where mood is undefined. Create src/lib/__tests__/mood.test.ts: empty list -> all zero; rows with undefined mood ignored; correct counts across a mixed list.
Optional: show the mood breakdown on src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx as a small summary (reuse MOOD_LABELS + icons). Guard the empty case.
acceptance_criteria: FastingSessionRecord.mood/note are written via sessions.setMoodNote; capture happens after a fast is saved and is fully skippable (never blocks stop/complete).
History rows show a mood indicator only when mood is set and can be tapped to edit mood/note; older rows with undefined mood/note render without error.
src/lib/mood.ts moodBreakdown is pure, ignores undefined-mood rows, and is covered by passing tests.
`npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/mood.test.ts` passes; `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npm run build` succeeds; no-emoji scan green.
findings:
DONE. Verified: scoped `npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/mood.test.ts` 3 passed; `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; full `npx vitest run` 227 passed across 11 files (baseline 185 -> grew with FEAT-001/002/003 + 2 new no-emoji scan entries for src/lib/mood.ts and src/features/history/MoodNoteSheet.tsx + 3 mood unit tests); `npm run lint` 0 errors (only the 2 PRE-EXISTING warnings in src/lib/notifications.ts:162 and src/lib/recommendation.ts:256, both untouched); `npm run build` OK (route /stats 2.38kB, /history 5.7kB). Layout + SW/notifications files byte-identical to HEAD (empty diff).

WHAT SHIPPED (FEAT-004, Feature 6 mood + note per session):
- src/lib/mood.ts (NEW, pure, React-free, no @/db): moodBreakdown(sessions: FastingSessionRecord[]): Record<Mood, number> seeds all four moods to 0 and skips rows where mood === undefined (older rows safe). src/lib/__tests__/mood.test.ts (NEW): empty -> all zero, undefined-mood rows ignored, mixed-list counts.
- src/types/index.ts: added 4 IconKeys mood_energik/mood_biasa/mood_lemes/mood_lapar (no other type changes; Mood + mood?/note? already existed from FEAT-001).
- src/components/ui/Icon.tsx: mapped the 4 keys to VERIFIED io5 names IoBatteryChargingOutline/IoRemoveCircleOutline/IoBatteryDeadOutline/IoFastFoodOutline; map still `satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType>`.
- src/lib/copy.ts: added MOOD_LABELS: Record<Mood, string> (Energik/Biasa aja/Lemes/Lapar, no emoji) next to GOAL_LABELS, and a copy.mood namespace (sheetTitle 'Gimana rasanya puasa tadi?', intro, moodLabel, noteLabel, notePlaceholder, save 'Simpan', skip 'Lewati', indicatorAria, editAria, summaryTitle, summaryEmpty). Imported Mood into copy.ts.
- src/features/history/MoodNoteSheet.tsx (NEW, 'use client', reuses Sheet): props { open; sessionId: number | null; initialMood?; initialNote?; onClose }. Four mood chips (role=radiogroup/radio, toggle-off supported) via Icon + MOOD_LABELS, optional note textarea (trimmed empty -> undefined), Simpan calls sessions.setMoodNote(sessionId, { mood, note }) only when sessionId !== null then closes, Lewati/scrim just closes. Re-seeds state on open. Never blocks.
- Post-stop capture (skippable, non-blocking): TimerControls.handleStopConfirm captures `const id = await stopFast()` and opens the sheet when id !== null (destructive Sudahi path). FastingTimer.handleStop does the same for the complete-prompt Sudahi path. Each hosts its own MoodNoteSheet instance keyed by a moodSessionId state (null hides). Existing toasts + clearScheduled preserved; stop flow unchanged otherwise.
- src/features/history/SessionRow.tsx: content area is now a tappable button (aria copy.mood.editAria) opening MoodNoteSheet prefilled with session.mood/note (sessionId = session.id ?? null); delete button stays a sibling (its own ConfirmDialog) so taps don't collide. Mood indicator (icon + MOOD_LABELS) renders only when session.mood !== undefined (older rows guarded).
- src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx (optional step done): MoodSummaryCard reads moodBreakdown(list) and returns null when total === 0 (empty guard); otherwise shows the four moods with counts via Icon + MOOD_LABELS, placed after the weekly chart inside the non-empty branch.

NO deviations. HARD RULES honored: zero emoji (scan green), all copy in copy.ts, all icons via Icon.tsx with verified io5 names, no `any`, layout/SW/notifications untouched. Committed locally on main staging only the 10 touched/new files by name; not pushed.
